brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Seamline, the open-source command-line tool in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: precise, trustworthy, developer-native; it must work in a terminal-heavy README, as a GitHub avatar and on a small docs site. No database cylinders, no elephants, no generic terminal prompt. Web and GitHub only.

claim.notes: No concept passed the gate: c2-seam and c3-s were struck at sketch review, and c1-step failed the blind gate in both rounds (git-commit-icon reading, distinctiveness 4), so nothing was finalized, exported or put in a gallery.

concepts.title: Expand and Contract
readsAs: a git commit node on a line (GitHub's commit icon)
a fuse / schematic component on a wire
a bypass lane splitting and rejoining. Unfortunate: a generic git-commit/branch-merge UI glyph, which this exact audience sees all day
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 a square-wave pulse / Pi / torii gate (signal-icon cliche, duplicated by c3 s2); s2 two offset rounded squares, a sliced-bar cut, also a camera/toggle - struck; s3 a component on a wire, a frame on a rod, then a line splitting into two lanes and rejoining; s4 hamburger/text-align icon - struck. Keep s3: two parallel lanes on one axis is the only sketch that says expand/contract (old and new running side by side, then rejoining), not just 'a detour'. Fix: drop the amber lid bar (reads as a hinge/lid and makes it a box); make both lanes equal weight so it reads as two paths, not a frame; consider rounding the fork joins or making the loop a lozenge so it stops looking like a resistor/chip on a trace; tighten the stubs so the 16 px render is not a minus sign with a square. Risk: generic 'node on a line' timeline glyph - it must gain one ownable detail.

concepts.title: Invisible Join
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 a staircase or step-line chart, really a stepped S with a color split (initial plus step, struck); s2 a square spiral or Greek-key S, or interlocking brackets: stock interlock, 58% stock-shape (struck); s3 the git-merge or road-merge icon, also a > chevron (UI icon, struck); s4 audio-mixer sliders or a fence/HH; the over-under thread is invisible because the navy is drawn as two separate bars (UI icon, struck; one-color merges the layers). Every sketch struck. A different move to try: drop two-color merge and join metaphors. Make one continuous stroke whose single crossing is visible in one color through a real gap. Also avoid the S and any arrow or lane geometry.

concepts.title: Two-Stroke S
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 the numeral 8 or an ampersand; the S only comes through once you are told (a different letter, struck); s4 a cursive S or a script 8, closer to a signature or handwriting than a tool: it contradicts precise and developer-native, and at 16 px it is an 8 (struck). Both are the same loop-S, and the stitch idea does not read: a self-crossing reads as a loop, not a tie-off. A different move to try: if the S stays, the stitch must be a visible discrete mark, such as a short crossing tick through a geometric monoline S with a gap at the crossing. No closed loop, which is what turns it into an 8.
